name: wasi-flow-editor
description: Stage 1 spike: React + React Flow (@xyflow/react) flow editor. Own package.json, own node_modules, own build — deliberately isolated from the root app.js/index.html (no build step) and from server/ (its own package.json). Built by the Dockerfile's flow-editor-build stage; only the built static output (dist/) ships in the final image, never this project's node_modules.
